violation_type.title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms (26 TAC §747.4401(9))
violation_type.short_title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms
violation_type.typical_finding: The patio has about a 3 foot drop on the two sides and about 15 stairs in front. The provider is going to create a protective barrier around the patio, but it was not complete at the time of inspection.

finding_variants.text: The patio has about a 3 foot drop on the two sides and about 15 stairs in front. The provider is going to create a protective barrier around the patio, but it was not complete at the time of inspection.
The porch in the outside area does not contain a protective barrier.
The back porch in the outdoor play area is higher than 20 inches and lacks a barrier.
